name: reserva-de-salas
description: Atalhos npm para os comandos do Docker Compose. Não há dependências Node: tudo roda nos containers.

scripts.predev: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('.env') || (console.error('Falta o .env. Rode: cp .env.example .env (e edite a SECRET_KEY)'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.seed
scripts.openapi: docker compose exec -T api python -m app.scripts.exportar_openapi > contrato/openapi.json
